title: Group Project Disagreement
goal: Navigate collaborative discussions and compromises respectfully.
parent_tips: Encourage active listening and validating other viewpoints.

content.scenario: Your group disagrees on which topic to choose for a presentation. Everyone has a different preference.

options.text: Suggest listing each idea on a board and voting together.
options.explanation: Fair, structured, and respects everyone's voice.

options.text: Insist on your own idea and refuse to listen to others.
options.explanation: Can cause frustration and halt teamwork.

options.text: Stay silent and let others argue.
options.explanation: Avoids conflict, but your perspective is lost.

strengths_message: Great collaborative problem-solving! Communication bridges differences.
